source: x0x calibration with a hand-derived Env Mod law (listening test)
reference_set: SET-E3 / D3 / C3 resonant-peak sweep tracks (tools/sweep_track.py)
notes: x0x.json with the Env Mod law and accent sweep read off the SET-E3 / SET-D3 resonant-peak tracks (tools/sweep_track.py) instead of the full optimizer. Env Mod depth 0.69 + 4.37 * EnvMod^2 octaves at both Cutoff ends (envModTaperExp 2), bias offset 0.35, cutoff trim 240 Hz. Accent sweep (2026-09-28, second pass): C13 charges fast (R46 7.8 ms, pot 21.8 ms, mix 122 ms), depth 2.66 oct, accented MEG decay kept at 69 ms, matched on the 8 accented E3/D3 saws (peak / half / quarter times within ~5-15 ms). All 400 notes: sweep error 6.39 -> 5.63 semitones (E3 5.3 -> 3.7, E5 4.6 -> 3.6, D rows ~1.5 better), weighted error 3.43 -> 3.63. Not yet addressed: the Decay pot law is too fast at 50-75 % (SET-E4), Cutoff 75 % sits ~0.3 oct low (D rows), Env Mod 75 % depth ~0.4 oct short.
